answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on two NLP tasks: 1) natural language understanding (NLU, on GLUE) and 2) language generation (on Wikitext-2 and ABCD).
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates language generation outputs on Wikitext-2 and ABCD, using perplexity as the main metric.

answer_2.quote: We note that language generation is different from NLU tasks... for the generation task, the "No-fine-tune" GPT2 is already a strong model for initialization with ppl=30.08 on Wikitext-2 and 13.60 on ABCD...
